info.title: Blaaiz Platform API - Request file upload URL
info.description:
Get a pre-signed URL to upload customer documents. 
 IMPORTANT: For the identity file category, only a Driver's License or Passport is accepted for individual customers. For business customers, only a Certificate of Incorporation is accepted. ID cards (National Identity Cards) are NOT accepted. No other document types are supported. 
 All uploaded documents must be clear, legible, and authentic. Blurry, cropped, obscured, or unclear images will not be reviewed and will be rejected. Fraudulent or falsified documents will not be tolerated — repeated attempts will result in the customer being permanently blacklisted from the platform. There are no exceptions or compromises.

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Use your OAuth client credentials to obtain a short-lived Bearer token from POST /oauth/token.

FileUploadRequest.description:
This endpoint allows you to request a pre-signed URL to upload a file for a customer. You will specify the file type you want to upload and for whom. 
 
 File Category 
 identity - Identity document. Required to verify a customer. IMPORTANT: Only a Driver's License or Passport is accepted for individual customers. Only a Certificate of Incorporation is accepted for business customers. ID cards (National Identity Cards) are NOT accepted. No other document types are supported. 
 proof_of_address - Proof of address. 
 liveness_check - Liveness check. 
 
 Document quality: All uploaded documents must be clear, legible, and authentic. Blurry, cropped, obscured, or unclear images will not be reviewed and will be rejected. Fraudulent or falsified documents will not be tolerated — repeated attempts will result in the customer being permanently blacklisted from the platform.

url.description: Pre-signed URL to upload the file

headers.description: Headers to include when uploading the file

post.description:
Request a pre-signed URL to upload a file for a customer.

Upload process:
1. Make a PUT request to the upload_url.
2. Include the headers from the response.
3. Send the file as binary data in the request body.
4. Once uploaded, use the file_id to attach the file to the customer record.

IMPORTANT — Accepted identity documents: Only a Driver's License or Passport is accepted for individual customers. Only a Certificate of Incorporation is accepted for business customers. ID cards (National Identity Cards) are NOT accepted. No other document types are supported.

IMPORTANT — Document quality: All uploaded documents must be clear, legible, and authentic. Blurry, cropped, obscured, or unclear images will not be reviewed and will be rejected. Fraudulent or falsified documents will not be tolerated — repeated attempts will result in the customer being permanently blacklisted from the platform. There are no exceptions or compromises.

Required scope: `file:upload`.
